summary: Auditoría de Taller report tested end-to-end. Backend: 9/9 pytest pass (12 TEST_AUD_ equipos + TEST quotes/quote_history covering all matrix pairs: Recibido without quote OK, Recibido with quote ALERTA, Cotizado/Enviada, En reparación/Aprobada, Reparado/Facturada, Pagado/Pagada OK, Entregado archived OK, Entregado in quote_history OK, Entregado not archived, En reparación with Enviada, Cotizado without quote, Pagado without quote -> 'Pagada' label). Filters resultado/estatus/q/desde-hasta (ingreso & actualizacion) correct; export xlsx serials+diagnostics identical to screen; 403 for a non-admin with taller_auditoria=none; unauthenticated is rejected. Real data KPIs: 1160 total / 714 OK / 446 inconsistencias / 0 alertas, matching the self-check. UI: the sidebar link works, the filter defaults to Solo Inconsistencias, KPIs show correctly, inconsistency rows are red, Consultar and the filters work, and Exportar Excel downloads the file. /admin/profiles lists Auditoría de Taller under Gestión de Taller as Inactivo, and all 12 profiles have 'none'. A non-admin sees no menu item, and the direct URL redirects to /dashboard.

minor.issue: 291 equipos have a quote_id/quote_number that points to a quote that no longer exists in quotes or quote_history (e.g. serial 346731133 -> quo_5ace9a097d99 / COT-2026-03-339-PYME). They show as 'no posee cotización registrada' and the UI shows '-- SIN COTIZ. --', which hides the dangling reference. Consider a separate diagnosis such as 'cotización vinculada (X) no existe' so these can be fixed.

issues: Desde/Hasta use the browser's native date input (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of the shadcn Calendar/date picker used elsewhere; the format is also inconsistent with the dd/mm/yyyy dates in the table

action_items: Optional: add a distinct diagnosis for equipos whose linked quote_id no longer exists (291 rows)
Optional: replace native date inputs with the shadcn date picker

Update /app/memory/test_credentials.md: kherrera password is neither 'Kherrera2026*Qa' nor 'Test1234!' (both fail verify_password against the DB hash). The test made 1 failed login (failed_login_attempts=1).
critical_code_review_comments: _build loads up to 20000 equipos and filters q/date in Python. This is fine at 1160 rows, but q/date filters could be pushed into the Mongo query as the data grows.
Date filter compares string prefix fecha[:10]; it falls back to created_at when fecha_ingreso/updated_at is missing. That is acceptable but undocumented.
Frontend export uses the client-side date for the filename while the backend uses the UTC date. This is harmless.
test_credentials: Admin qa.integradores works. kherrera@megasoft.com.ve / Kherrera2026*Qa FAILS (invalid credentials). RBAC was tested with a temporary clone (test_aud_rbac@example.com, same profile prof_bacef16026), which was deleted afterwards.
seed_data_creation: TEST_AUD_<tag>_ equipos, quotes and quote_history were created by the test fixture and deleted by id on teardown. Verified 0 leftovers. The temporary TEST user and its sessions were deleted. No real data was modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && AUD_NONADMIN_EMAIL=<user> AUD_NONADMIN_PW=<pw> python -m pytest tests/test_taller_audit.py -p no:xdist. Use a non-admin with taller_auditoria=none for the 403 test. The default uses kherrera creds, which are currently wrong. The UI login was done by injecting session_token/user into localStorage after the API login.
